project_context.pipeline_diagram:
flowchart LR
    C[Configuration] --> D[Market bars and tick quotes]
    D --> K[Versioned data and feature caches]
    K --> F[Features and date split]
    F --> E[Trading simulation and execution costs]
    E --> M[Model encoder and RL policy]
    M --> T[Training and checkpoint]
    T --> V[Evaluation on the recorded split]
    V --> R[Metrics, trade records, and plots]
    X[Campaign and run manifests] -. record identity .-> D
    X -. record identity .-> T
    X -. record identity .-> V

policy_context.observation_visibility: feature row is available after its bar closes

source_map.name: Configuration
source_map.purpose: Defines data, date splits, features, trading rules, and learner settings.

source_map.name: Market data
source_map.purpose: Loads bars and tick quotes; prepares timeframes and saved data caches.

source_map.name: Features and split
source_map.purpose: Builds model inputs and assigns observations to configured date periods.

source_map.name: Trading simulation
source_map.purpose: Applies policy actions, simulated orders, costs, fills, and account updates.

source_map.name: Model and learner
source_map.purpose: Encodes feature history and fits a PPO or SAC policy.

source_map.name: Training workflow
source_map.purpose: Prepares runs, learns, saves checkpoints, and records run artifacts.

source_map.name: Evaluation and plots
source_map.purpose: Replays policies, calculates metrics, creates diagnostic plots and reports.

source_map.name: Campaign identity
source_map.purpose: Records variant state, source/data identity, checkpoints, and output paths.

variants.example_rule: up to five trades nearest each category median net PnL; BE means explicit BE exit or within tolerance
